title: Taiwanese Association of America – New Jersey 紐澤西 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of America – New Jersey (TAA-NJ, 紐澤西台灣同鄉會) is a chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations. The chapter serves Taiwanese Americans in central New Jersey and the surrounding vicinity, and is listed under the TAA’s Eastern Northern (美東北) regional grouping.
